stem: Two sibling plants from the same cross show noticeably different traits. Which explanation is most consistent with breeding genetics?
choices: Segregation, recombination and genotype-by-environment effects can produce phenotypic variation among related offspring
All siblings from a cross must be genetically and phenotypically identical
Phenotype uniquely reveals the entire underlying genotype
Environmental conditions cannot influence expressed traits
rationale: Sexual reproduction produces genetic segregation and recombination, and expressed phenotype can also depend on environmental context.
